title: Reward Budgeting Reduces Premature Convergence in Reinforcement Learning for LLM Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2611.05942v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: RL for LLM reasoning often reaches an early performance plateau as the policy distribution becomes increasingly sharp. Recent work has studied policy entropy as both a diagnostic and a control signal for this behavior. In our experiments, however, increasing entropy alone does not reliably change the eventual plateau. We analyze RL through its implicit target policy and derive a sharpness factor $\kappa$, together with an effective counterpart $\kappa_{\mathrm{eff}}$, that describes how strongly reward or advantage gaps are translated into probability-ratio gaps. Motivated by this view, we introduce \emph{reward budgeting}, a plug-in advantage construction that assigns a fixed total reward budget to each prompt. translated_title: 奖励预算化：减少大语言模型推理强化学习中的过早收敛
translated_abstract: 面向大语言模型（LLM）推理的强化学习（RL）常常随着策略分布变得越来越尖锐而过早进入性能平台期。近期研究将策略熵作为这一行为的诊断信号和控制信号。然而我们的实验表明，仅仅增加熵并不能可靠地改变最终的平台期。我们通过RL的隐式目标策略对其进行分析，推导出一个尖锐度因子 $\kappa$ 及其有效对应量 $\kappa_{\mathrm{eff}}$，用以刻画奖励或优势差距被转化为概率比差距的强度。基于这一视角，我们提出了“奖励预算化”，这是一种插件式的优势构造方法，为每个提示分配固定的总奖励预算。对于二元奖励和独立的on-policy采样，其未截断的得分函数估计器遵循一个精确的、具有收益递减特性的有限-$G$ 凹目标的梯度，而其优势差距随着更多采样的进行而减小……
tldr: 该论文提出“奖励预算化”这一插件式优势构造方法，通过为每个提示分配固定的总奖励预算来缩小优势差距，从而有效缓解大语言模型推理强化学习中的过早收敛与早期性能平台期问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes "reward budgeting," a plug-in advantage construction that assigns a fixed total reward budget to each prompt, thereby shrinking advantage gaps and mitigating premature convergence and early performance plateaus in reinforcement learning for LLM reasoning.
